SessionStart._comment: At the start of each chat (a new chat, /clear, a fork) it marks the chat with the person's zero-touch mode and models from the settings box, and shows one message saying what is in force (again after a compaction or a reopened chat). The mmo plugin, which holds all of zero-touch's workflow and hand-off code, acts only in a chat so marked. Always exits 0.

UserPromptSubmit._comment: The settings box: in the first chat after install it reminds Claude to open the box first; after a box that was closed without an answer it says nothing was saved. Leaves at once (no node) in every other chat.

PreToolUse._comment: The settings box, before it is shown: a box about zero-touch must be exactly the one expected now (mode first, then models or the hand-off questions), or it is refused with the exact box. Other boxes pass untouched.
The first chat after install only: tools that change anything wait until the settings box has been shown. Leaves at once (no node) in every other chat.

PostToolUse._comment: The settings box, after the person answered: the clicks are read, checked against the fixed choices and saved, all or nothing; the person sees one line saying what is saved.
